subject: FintechCo renewal: request for public reference & case study
messages:
From: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick favor: reference for our renewal

Hi Marissa and Vanessa,

We're starting the internal renewal approval for our enterprise contract and the procurement team has requested a short public reference or customer quote that highlights outcomes — specifically around latency improvements and cost per inference. Would Redwood be willing to provide a short one-paragraph quote and join a 15-minute call with our procurement lead (cc'd Priya) next week?

High level outcomes that helped us: 30% P50 latency improvement after moving to the dedicated pool, and ~22% token cost reduction after implementing the auto-batching/caching profile you recommended. If you can provide a one-paragraph quote that mirrors those metrics, that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Willis
Head of Platform Engineering
FintechCo

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Willis <jordan.willis@fintechco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-10T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick favor: reference for our renewal

Jordan — thanks for the ask and congrats on the renewal process kicking off. We can absolutely help. I'll draft a one-paragraph customer quote and pull together a short case study draft you can review.

Quick Qs before we draft: would you prefer an anonymized outcome quote or a FintechCo-branded one? Also, if procurement needs a signed reference release, we can provide our standard case study release (I can send that over).

I put Vanessa on cc to align on timing — Vanessa, are we good to aim for a one-paragraph quote + draft case study by Thursday?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2025-09-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick favor: reference for our renewal — internal plan

Team — forwarding Jordan's request. TL;DR: FintechCo wants a short public reference + 15m call. They cited measurable outcomes (P50 latency -30%, token cost -22%). Renewal is expected to move to legal this week.

Proposed plan:
- Vanessa: prepare one-paragraph quote (non-technical) and coordinate 15m with Jordan/Priya.
- Stephanie (CS): I need a short case study draft that highlights the deployment steps and the metrics; include a single slide (Q3 results) for procurement.
- Vivek (RevOps): estimate if there's any customer-facing pricing/credit we should propose to smooth approval (we already have an ROI slide showing 6-month payback).

Timing: Vanessa/Stephanie aim for first drafts by 9/12 EOD so I can send to Jordan for approval on 9/15.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: none

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Case study draft + quote for FintechCo (attached)

Hi all,

Attached: "Redwood_case_study_draft.docx" and a one-slide summary "Fintech_Q3_results_slide.pdf". I pulled the language conservative for legal — callout the exact metrics Fintech provided and offered quote options: branded and anonymized.

Excerpt of proposed quote (option A, branded):
"Redwood's dedicated pool reduced our median inference latency by ~30% and lowered token costs by roughly 22%, enabling our fraud-detection feature to operate at production scale without increasing operational spend." — Jordan Willis, Head of Platform Engineering, FintechCo

Legal: please confirm the release language is fine for a public case study and whether we need a signed release form. Stephanie — if you can tidy the deployment section and add a one-paragraph customer quote variant for them to choose, that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Marissa/Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround. We ran the draft by procurement/legal here. We're happy with the branded quote option A, but would like two small edits in the deployment paragraph to call out "dedicated GPU pool" explicitly and to change "~22%" to "~21.5%" for accuracy in their procurement slides.

We're good to be a public reference and can join the 15-minute call on 2025-09-18 at 10:00 AM ET. Priya will send a calendar invite.

Jordan
